biggest_catch: Voice123's official rate figures are client-side reference budgets, not guaranteed worker pay, and there is no concrete official payout timing.
catches: No official guaranteed worker pay: fees are negotiated between client and voice actor on an open marketplace.
Official 'rates' ($50-$200 for up to 1 finished minute) are client reference budgets, not what every actor earns.
'New voice actors might start with $100-$500 per project' is vague guidance, not a concrete pay figure.
Paid subscription plans ($49-$4950/year) are required for meaningful access to job invitations.
No concrete official payout schedule for talent.
